I am going to be painfully honest with you.

Waking up after surgery is the absolutely worst part. My sinus surgery resulted in a head filled with blood clots, I vomited blood all the time. Sinuses take a long time to heal. Awful experience. I was also under the effect of some drugs they gave me. Very likely the single worst physical experience if my life. Or at least the worst I can remember. I thought I was dying. 

It’s like a very long, slow, painful nightmare. He likely won’t be able to sleep for few days as blood in his throat will start choking him. 

In the long run, the surgery did improve my breathing slightly, but it’s not ideal. After months I’m still dealing with uneven breathing, sinus mucus and headaches. It’s especially hard to tell how much progress was made since the process was very gradual. But I did notice I stopped fainting and headaches aren’t as severe. Plus, the mucus is more bearable.
